import html # Base template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ User Content

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def render_html_output(user_input: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML page embedding the user-provided content safely. Parameters ---------- user_input : str Content supplied by the user that should appear in the page. Returns ------- str The complete HTML page with the escaped user content inserted. """ # Escape any characters that could be interpreted as HTML or JavaScript safe_content = html.escape(user_input, quote=True) # Substitute the escaped content into the template return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
